messages:
maria-support: FYI customer reported 403s that look like invalid API key errors. They say the key is correct and working in other envs. Posting their curl + response below.
maria-support: Customer repro ->

```
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":{"message":"invalid API key or token","type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```
maria-support: Customer claims they just upgraded plan but still get 403. Billing shows upgrade completed ~3m before the call. Opening ticket for entitlement vs auth confusion.
jon-eng: Can you paste request-id / any gateway logs? If gateway returns generic msg we should surface reason header.
maria-support: Request-ID: rq_0a9f2b3c. I pulled gateway logs:
```
[gw] rq_0a9f2b3c -> auth.check key=sk_live_ABC123 ok
[gw] rq_0a9f2b3c -> entitlement.check tenant=acme-123 result=DENY reason=insufficient_plan
[gw] rq_0a9f2b3c -> respond 403 body="invalid API key or token"
```
jon-eng: Ah — gateway is translating entitlement DENY into generic auth 403. That's the root cause.
ali-ps: Customer-facing confusion: they see "invalid API key" and either re-issue keys or escalate to account team. We should make error explicit: ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED or at least mention plan/feature gate.
sre-lex: Could be a sync race between billing and entitlement cache. How long after upgrade did they call again?
maria-support: Billing shows success at 2026-03-17T12:43:02Z, first failing call at 12:45:05Z. That's ~2m.
jon-eng: 2m might be inside cache TTL for the entitlement service (we have a 5m in-memory TTL on the policy cache). Two options: short-term: change gateway to include original entitlement reason in a header (x-entitlement-reason) so SDKs can show it. Long-term: return a distinct error payload.
ryan-product: We also need to consider contract/billing semantics. Some customers expect immediate access post-upgrade. We should clearly document eventual consistency window and improve messaging.
ali-ps: Proposed quick customer response: inform them it's not an API key issue, confirm plan shows active, and either wait up to 5 minutes or request support to force a cache invalidate for their tenant. Offer temporary manual grant if urgent.
maria-support: Customer asked for a workaround — can we force a cache invalidate? any admin endpoint?
jon-eng: There's an admin endpoint on entitlement service: `POST /admin/tenants/{id}/invalidate-cache` (internal only). I can run it if PM approves. Otherwise we can ask infra to nudge the cache.
sre-lex: I can run the invalidate but want logging id. maria please confirm tenant id and get customer permission for manual action.
maria-support: Tenant id acme-123. Customer approved manual invalidate.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: entitlement-service admin endpoint invoked by sre-lex: /admin/tenants/acme-123/invalidate-cache -> 200
sre-lex: Ran invalidate at 2026-03-17T12:48:21Z. After that I see entitlement.check -> ALLOW in gateway logs for the same key.
```
[gw] rq_0b0f3c4d -> auth.check key=sk_live_ABC123 ok
[gw] rq_0b0f3c4d -> entitlement.check tenant=acme-123 result=ALLOW
[gw] rq_0b0f3c4d -> respond 200
```
maria-support: Customer confirmed call succeeded after ~30s. They were unblocked.
jon-eng: Root cause: cache TTL + generic error mapping. Action items:
- (ENG) Change gateway to add x-entitlement-reason header when entitlement denies (short-term) — jon
- (ENG) Return distinct error body code for entitlement failures: {"error":{"code":"ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED","message":"Upgrade required or plan does not include feature"}} — jon
- (PRODUCT) Update billing docs & UI to state expected propagation window — ryan
- (SUPPORT) Add KB article and canned response for this scenario — maria
ali-ps: Also add metrics: count of 403s where entitlement_reason present vs auth_failure.
jon-eng: I'll open a PR for header + distinct body. Quick patch can go to canary gateway in next deploy.
ryan-product: Also think about UX — maybe surface a modal telling customer plan change is pending until propagation completes. Filing a product ticket.
maria-support: Created KB draft. Link: https://internal.redwood.ai/kb/403-plan-gate (WIP)
jon-eng: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/gateway/pull/4822 - includes header + new error code. Rolling to canary after review.
sre-lex: After we deploy, support should confirm customer sees new payload. We can also add a CloudTrail event for manual invalidates.
maria-support: I'll follow up with customer tomorrow to confirm all good and share KB. Thanks everyone.
ryan-product: Logging for product: #prod-12345 created to track larger UX/consistency change.
maria-support: Closing this Slack thread and adding to ticket: TICKET-5124.
jon-eng: Low-risk change but high-impact for support noise. Good catch.
